watches.name: Marine M003-07
watches.description: Introducing the NOVE Marine - a timepiece that embodies the essence of opulence and refinement. Crafted with the utmost precision and unwavering attention to detail, the Marine is a testament to the artistry that lies at the heart of Swiss watchmaking. Immerse yourself in the allure of this extraordinary timepiece, adorned with a skeletonized functional inner dive bezel construction that exudes an air of mystery and intrigue. The captivating interplay of light and shadow creates a mesmerizing dance that invites you to explore the depths of possibility. With its screw-down crowns and water resistance of up to 200 meters, the Marine is as fearless as it is elegant. Designed for those who appreciate the thrill of adventure, this exceptional timepiece effortlessly combines form and function, allowing you to navigate the open waters with confidence and grace. Powered by a Swiss Automatic movement, cal. SW200, the Marine is a testament to precision and reliability. The sleek double-curved Sapphire Crystal serves as a reminder of the enduring mastery that resides within. Embrace the night with the highest quality and strength Swiss Super-LumiNova C3. The luminescent glow of the Marine adds an ethereal touch and ensures that time is never lost, even in the depths of the unknown. Encased in 316L stainless steel, the Marine is a symbol of strength and durability. Its robust construction is a testament to the enduring craftsmanship that NOVE stands for. The interchangeable bracelet allows you to adapt your timepiece to suit your every mood and occasion, adding a touch of versatility to this extraordinary creation. As a mark of our unwavering dedication to excellence, the Marine comes with a 3-year warranty, ensuring that your investment is protected and cherished for years to come. With every glance at your wrist, allow the Marine to remind you of the extraordinary path you have chosen - one where time becomes a canvas for self-expression, and the ordinary becomes extraordinary. Elevate your timekeeping experience with the NOVE Marine - where the art of Swiss craftsmanship is reimagined, and the boundaries of luxury are pushed. Embrace the extraordinary and embark on a timeless journey that reflects your unique style and spirit. As you embark on this remarkable adventure, let the NOVE Marine be your trusted companion, a symbol of your exquisite taste and indomitable spirit.

watches.name: NOVE Modena Chronograph K003-02
watches.description: This elegant design demonstrates once again a precise case architecture typifying the luxury of elite automotive performance. Fine detail inspired by the elegant and aggressive design of the world’s finest motorcars sets this timepiece in a league of its own. Utilizing streamlined Lugs design framing a minimalist air in-take, brake system bezel-crown guards and other details inspired by high end automotive design, the Modena collection represents the next level of Nove performance. Modena Chronograph is no exception. High precision in micro scale has been employed to create a complicated multi-layered dial scheme with multiple functions. Each of the chrono-eyes feature a double ring stack with three poles in between. This gives the Chronograph the unique feel of engine components typical of high performance. Screw down pushers and screw crown feature a paired design combine with a hydraulic stamped case back to provide strong air-tightness water resistance to depths up to 200 Meters.
